text.description_html:
Acorn RIJBP, 20-1/2" Heart Tip Iron Strap Hinge With Pintle

The 20-1/2" Heart Tip Iron Strap Hinge With Pintle has a rough iron finish. Its functionality does not overlook appearance. Designed for gates 3 inches to 4 inches thick up to 175 lbs, this iron strap hinge will be sure to add an authentic old world finishing touch to any door. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron.

Also Available: 17 Inch Heart Tip Rough Iron Strap Hinge For Gates With Wood Screws

Features of the 20-1/2" Rough Iron Heart Tip Strap Hinge:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the Rough Iron Heart Tip Strap Gate Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Designed for gates 3" to 4" thick up to 175 lbs.
  • Length: 20-1/2"
  • Width: 1-3/4"
  • Gauge: .155
  • Pintle: 4-1/2"

Sold Individually
